skills.name: Aircraft Maintenance Licence (CAAM Part-66 / CAAS SAR-66)
Aircraft type rating (Boeing 737, Airbus A320, ATR 72, Boeing 777)
Aircraft systems troubleshooting and fault diagnosis
Aircraft Maintenance Manual (AMM), IPC and ATA chapter documentation
Airworthiness Directives (AD) and Service Bulletin (SB) compliance
Line maintenance and base maintenance checks (A-check, C-check)
Maintenance management software (AMOS, TRAX, Ramco Aviation)
Non-destructive testing (NDT: dye penetrant, eddy current, ultrasonic)
Human Factors and Safety Management System (SMS) training
Engine boroscope inspection and engine ground run
Sheet metal and composite structural repair

local_notes: In Malaysia a CAAM Part-66 licence and in Singapore a CAAS SAR-66 licence (or an accepted EASA Part-66/FAA A&P with type ratings on the B737, A320 or ATR 72 fleets serviced by local MROs such as SIA Engineering, ST Engineering and Malaysia Airlines Engineering) are the standard entry requirements.
